marks.gloss_en: Rabban Gamliel: one who ate grapes, figs and pomegranates blesses after them three blessings
שהפת טפלה לו -- the bread is secondary to the salted food
if salted food was brought before him first, and bread with it, he blesses over the salted food and exempts the bread
מאי טעמא דרבן גמליאל? דכתיב: ארץ חטה ושערה... ארץ אשר לא במסכנת תאכל בה לחם... ואכלת ושבעת וברכת
Rabban Gamliel's reason: it is written 'a land of wheat and barley...', and 'a land where you will eat bread without scarcity...', and 'you shall eat and be satisfied and bless the Lord your God'
ורבנן -- ״ארץ״ הפסיק העניין
ורבן גמליאל נמי ״ארץ״ הפסיק העניין! -- for Rabban Gamliel too the word 'land' interrupts the passage
ההוא מבעי ליה למעוטי הכוסס את החטה -- he needs that word to exclude one who chews wheat (= p_rg_lemaet_koses)
and the Sages: [the word] 'land' interrupts the passage
מתקיף לה רב נחמן בר יצחק: אינהו אכלי ואנן מברכין?! -- they eat [the Land's fruit], and we bless [over 'its fruits']?!
anything of the five species: at the start one blesses over it 'Who creates kinds of food'
anything of the seven species: at the start one blesses 'Who creates fruit of the tree'
over tree-fruit: 'for the tree and the fruit of the tree, and for the produce of the field, and for the desirable, good and spacious land... for You are good and do good to all'
[over] the five species: 'for the sustenance and for the nourishment and for the produce of the field...'
Rav closed on Rosh Chodesh: 'Blessed... who sanctifies Israel and the New Moons'
[the fruit blessing closes] 'for the land and for its fruits'
ומי איכא מידי דהוי מליח עיקר ופת טפלה? -- is there anything where salted food is primary and bread secondary?
אמר רב אחא בריה דרב עוירא אמר רב אשי: באוכלי פירות גינוסר שנו -- they taught it of those who eat fruits of Genosar (= p_okimta_ochlei_ginosar)
Rav Ashi: they taught it of those who eat fruits of Genosar

Rabba bar bar Chana: when we went after R' Yochanan to eat Genosar fruit, a hundred of us brought him ten each and ten of us a hundred each; every hundred filled a three-se'a basket, and he ate them all
R' Abbahu ate [Genosar fruit] until a fly would slide off his forehead
Rav Dimi: King Yannai had a city on the King's Mountain from which they took 600,000 bowls of small fish for the fig-cutters from Shabbat eve to Shabbat eve
Ravin: King Yannai had a tree on the King's Mountain from which they took down forty se'a of pigeons from three broods each month
Rav: any meal in which there is no salt is not a meal
